newsitem.title: CANADA: Chieftain bids on U.S. Gulf offshore blocks.
newsitem.headline: Chieftain bids on U.S. Gulf offshore blocks.

text.p: Chieftain International Inc said on Wednesday it participated in high bids for 20 offshore blocks covering 115,000 gross acres at the U.S. western Gulf of Mexico lease sale held in New Orleans.
Chieftain said it participated with a partner in 16 high bids and made four high bids independently. The company's average interest in the blocks was 61 percent.

If the U.S. Minerals Management Service accepted all Chieftain's high bids, its share of costs would be US$5.6 million and total offshore holdings in the Gulf would increase to 123 blocks, covering 627,000 gross (231,000 net) acres, it said.
